title: Little Fish: I believed it when Pythagoras said it
content:
Dan, Andy and Anna discuss YOUR facts including scaring cormorants, cleaning horses and recognising frogmen. Anna reveals what her first word was. And we name eight more Friend of the Podcast custodians.

The London Podcast Festival Club Fish presale begins TODAY - join us for a podcast recording, plus our first ever live Drop Us A Line! Here's how to access tickets:

Visit nosuchthingasafish.com/live and use the presale code NSTAAF

Edited by James Harkin

Produced by Leying Lee

Team includes Tara Dorrell, Joe Mayo and Ethan Ruparelia
